ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious CMD Shell Output Redirect
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects inline Windows shell commands redirecting output via the ">" symbol to a suspicious location.
This technique is sometimes used by malicious actors in order to redirect the output of reconnaissance commands such as "hostname" and "dir" to files for future exfiltration.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?\\%APPDATA\\%\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?\\%TEMP\\%\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?\\%TMP\\%\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?\\%USERPROFILE\\%\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>?C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\"\\>.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'\\>.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*"))))
